title: MCP tools
text: Return Area Y EIC codes (bidding zones, control areas, member states, etc.). Pass query string filter country name, ISO code, zone name (case-insensitive). IMPORTANT: Always display full table matches user ask confirm EIC code use querying data - many countries multiple bidding zones. query resolves MULTIPLE EICs (e.g. Germany least three: DE-LU bidding zone ‘10Y1001A1001A82H’, DE control area, historical DE--LU zone), MUST present every match area_type_code ask user use calling downstream tool. Day-ahead intraday PRICES published per BIDDING ZONE (BZN); LOAD published per CONTROL AREA (CTA); CROSS-BORDER flows transfer capacities published per BORDER. Pick EIC whose area_type_code matches domain need. Trigger phrases: ‘EIC code Germany’, ‘zone Austria’, ‘find bidding zone France’, ‘look EIC HU’.

title: MCP tools
text: Return Party X EIC codes market participants (TSOs, traders, etc.). Pass query string filter name country code.

title: MCP tools
text: Return approved EIC codes across types (Area, Party, Tie-line, Resource Object, Substation, etc.) one table. Slower area_eic() alone. Pass query string filter results.

title: MCP tools

title: MCP tools

title: MCP tools
text: Get real electricity consumption / demand data European country bidding zone (e.g. Germany, Austria, Hungary, France). Use request total load, power demand, electricity consumption, MW load profile, actual/forecast demand. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic load values. Prefer 1-3 day date ranges - 15-min data fills 100-row cap ~1 day; hourly data allows ~4 days. Max 1-year API limit. type: ‘actual’ (6.1., default), ‘day_ahead’ (6.1.B), ‘week_ahead’ (6.1.C), ‘month_ahead’ (6.1.D), ‘year_ahead’ (6.1.E), ‘margin’ (8.1 year-ahead margin). Use area_eic() find EIC code.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real electricity generation data fuel type technology European bidding zone. Use request actual generation, power output fuel type, fuel mix, renewable generation, solar output, wind power output, generation breakdown, electricity production technology (solar, wind, nuclear, hydro, gas, coal, biomass, etc.). Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic generation values. Prefer 1-3 day date ranges - 15-min data fills 100-row cap ~1 day; hourly data allows ~4 days. Max 1-year API limit. type: ‘actual’ (16.1.B&C per production type, default), ‘wind_solar’ (14.1.D forecast), ‘day_ahead’ (14.1.C aggregate forecast), ‘per_unit’ (16.1.per unit; one API request per day, sent parallel, keep ranges short), ‘storage’ (16.1.D hydro reservoir filling rate). gen_type: optional ENTSO-E production type code used ‘actual’/‘per_unit’, e.g. ‘B01’ Biomass, ‘B16’ Solar. ‘actual’ ‘per_unit’ paginated daily.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real installed generation capacity (MW) European bidding zone. Use request installed capacity, nameplate capacity, generation fleet, renewable capacity, nuclear capacity, power plant capacity technology type. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic capacity values. per_unit=FALSE (default): aggregate production type (14.1.). per_unit=TRUE: individual production unit level (14.1.C, granular).

title: MCP tools
text: Get real electricity market prices European bidding zones Germany (DE-LU), Austria (), Hungary (HU), France (FR), Italy (), Czech Republic (CZ), Romania (RO), etc. Use request power prices, spot prices, day-ahead prices, SDAC prices, EPEX prices, EUR/MWh electricity prices, ENTSO-E market price data. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic prices tool available. Technical: day-ahead intraday market clearing prices (12.1.D). Max 1-year API limit. contract_type: ‘A01’ = Day ahead (default), ‘A07’ = Intraday. Use area_eic() find EIC code. NOTE: ENTSO-E often publishes several TimeSeries per price document, stacked cached table. Column ts_classification_sequence_position tells apart: 1 = SDAC day-ahead price, 2 = second auction, often another resolution (ts_resolution PT15M vs PT60M). series can also repeat different ts_mrid. envelope WARNING lists columns, filter computing statistics (e.g. ts_classification_sequence_position = 1 ts_mrid = ), ask user series meant.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real continuous intraday electricity prices (XBID, ID prices) European bidding zone. Use request intraday market prices, continuous trading prices, ID auction results. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic prices. Specialised wrapper around intraday contract type. Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. NOTE: ENTSO-E can publish several TimeSeries per price document, stacked cached table. envelope WARNING lists columns ts_classification_sequence_position, ts_mrid ts_resolution, filter computing statistics (e.g. ts_classification_sequence_position = 1), ask user series meant.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real Net Transfer Capacities (NTC) two European bidding zones. Use request interconnection capacity, cross-border transfer capacity, import/export capacity countries. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic capacity values. Technical: NTC two bidding zones (11.1). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). contract_type: ‘A02’ = Day ahead (default), ‘A03’ = Intraday, ‘A04’ = Week ahead. Use area_eic() find EIC codes zones.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real day-ahead commercial schedules (nominations) two European bidding zones. Use requests DACF schedules, commercial nominations, scheduled cross-border exchanges. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic schedule values. Technical: day-ahead commercial schedules (12.1.F). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. Use area_eic() find EIC codes.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real explicit offered transfer capacities long-term capacity auctions (annual, monthly) two European bidding zones. Use requests explicit capacity auctions, long-term transmission rights, offered ATC auctions. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic capacity values. Technical: explicit offered transfer capacities (12.1.). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). contract_type: ‘A01’ = Day ahead (default).

title: MCP tools
text: Get real flow-based market coupling (FBMC) allocation results CWE Core region. Use requests flow-based allocations, FB MC results, Core region capacity, CWE flow-based data. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic allocation values. Technical: flow-based allocations (12.1.B) CWE/Core region. Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). process_type: ‘A43’ = Day ahead (default), ‘A32’ = Intraday.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real congestion income (congestion rent) bidding zone border. Use requests congestion revenue, auctioning income, transmission congestion rent. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic values. Technical: congestion income (12.1.G). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). contract_type: ‘A01’ = Day ahead (default).

title: MCP tools
text: Get real allocated transfer capacities borders third countries (non-EU: Ukraine, Serbia, Norway, Switzerland, etc.). Use requests third-country capacity auctions non-EU interconnection capacity. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic capacity values. Technical: allocated transfer capacities third-country borders (12.1.C). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). auction_category: ‘A01’ Annual, ‘A02’ Monthly, ‘A03’ Weekly, ‘A04’ Daily (default).

title: MCP tools
text: Get real physical electricity flows two European bidding zones. Use request actual cross-border flows, measured imports/exports, physical interconnection flows, electricity transfer countries. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic flow values. Technical: physical cross-border flows (12.1.G). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. Use area_eic() find EIC codes.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real total commercial schedules two European bidding zones. Use requests total scheduled exchanges, net commercial nominations, aggregated cross-border schedules. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic schedule values. Technical: total commercial schedules (12.1.F). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real net positions (net export/import balance) European bidding zone. Use requests net export position, net import position, bidding zone balance, export surplus/import deficit. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic position values. Technical: net positions (12.1.H). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. contract_type: ‘A01’ = Day ahead (default), ‘A07’ = Intraday.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real forecasted transfer capacities (ATC - Available Transfer Capacity) two European bidding zones. Use requests ATC, forecasted interconnection capacity, available cross-border transmission capacity. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic capacity values. Technical: forecasted transfer capacities (11.1). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). market_agreement_type: ‘A01’ = Day ahead (default), ‘A02’ = Total capacity.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real generation unit unavailability reports ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Use requests forced outages, planned maintenance generation units, nuclear outages, REMIT reports, unavailability power plants, generation unit outage data. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic outage records. Technical: unavailability generation units (15.1.&B). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. doc_status: ‘A05’ active, ‘A09’ cancelled, ‘A13’ withdrawn (NULL = active+cancelled). event_nature: ‘A53’ planned, ‘A54’ unplanned (NULL = ).

title: MCP tools
text: Get real production unit unavailability reports (REMIT notifications) ENTSO-E Transparency Platform. Use requests forced outages planned maintenance individual production units. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic outage records. Technical: unavailability production units (15.1.C&D). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. doc_status: ‘A05’ active, ‘A09’ cancelled, ‘A13’ withdrawn. event_nature: ‘A53’ planned, ‘A54’ unplanned.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real transmission grid unavailability reports specific border. Use requests grid outages, line outages, transmission maintenance, interconnection outages, REMIT grid reports. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic outage records. Technical: unavailability transmission grid (15.1.&B) border. Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. Requires eic_in eic_out affected border. doc_status: ‘A05’ active, ‘A09’ cancelled, ‘A13’ withdrawn. event_nature: ‘A53’ planned, ‘A54’ unplanned.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real imbalance settlement prices European scheduling area. Use requests balancing prices, system price, imbalance settlement price, BRP settlement price, balancing energy cost. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic price values. Technical: imbalance prices (17.1.D). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit. Use area_eic() find EIC code.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real imbalance volumes European scheduling area. Use requests system imbalance, total balancing volumes, TSO activation volumes, balancing energy volumes. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic volume values. Technical: imbalance volumes (17.1.C). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). Max 1-year API limit.

title: MCP tools
text: Get real contracted balancing reserve volumes European scheduling area. Use requests FCR (Frequency Containment Reserves), aFRR (automatic Frequency Restoration Reserves), mFRR (manual FRR), RR (Replacement Reserves), procured balancing capacity, balancing reserve procurement results. Returns actual ENTSO-E data - generate synthetic reserve values. Technical: contracted balancing reserves (17.1.B). Prefer 1-3 day date ranges (results capped 100 rows). market_agreement_type (required): ‘A01’ Daily, ‘A02’ Weekly, ‘A03’ Monthly, ‘A04’ Yearly, ‘A06’ Long-term, ‘A13’ Intraday. process_type (optional): ‘A46’ FCR, ‘A47’ mFRR, ‘A51’ aFRR, ‘A52’ RR.

title: MCP tools
text: Run SQL query (DuckDB dialect) tables cached session. Every time-series tool inserts full result session DuckDB returns table name; use sql_query aggregate, filter, join tables instead re-fetching ENTSO-E API. Full SELECT / / CREATE TEMP / INSERT etc. supported. Results returned CSV capped max_rows (default 100) - aggregate GROUP stay cap. plotting raw points, pass max_rows explicitly (e.g. 800 one month hourly data, 3000 15-min data); avoid values 5000 prefer GROUP aggregation. Use list_tables() describe_table() discover available tables. database sandboxed: file network access (read_csv, COPY , ATTACH, INSTALL) SET disabled, memory capped. DuckDB errors returned ‘# error: ’ can read retry.

text: List every table cached session’s DuckDB row counts column schemas. Returns CSV columns: table_name, rows, columns (semicolon-separated). Use sql_query() discover ’s available without re-calling ENTSO-E API. arguments.

what: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
text: MCP server exposes ENTSO-E Transparency Platform tools LLM-enabled applications Claude Desktop. Query European electricity market, load, generation, transmission, outages, balancing data natural language. Built pure R top entsoeapi mcptools. Distributed Docker image — R installation required end users. Large time-series results cached -process DuckDB inside container, LLM can aggregate, filter, join via SQL without flooding context window.

text: Every time-series tool inserts full result -memory DuckDB table returns envelope. envelope tells Claude — every call — statistics must computed via sql_query, never schema sample, warns several TimeSeries stacked together one cached table. real envelope Austrian day-ahead prices 12 October 2026: one day 15-minute prices, 288 rows, document holds classification sequence 2, sequence 1, sequence 1 third ts_mrid: Note ts_point_dt_start UTC (22:00 UTC midnight Vienna summer), ts_point_dt_start_cet holds instant Central European wall-clock time, daylight saving applied. server computes R sandboxed DuckDB load time-zone extension, fixed + INTERVAL 2 HOUR shift wrong changeover days. sample rows show sequence 2, Claude filter first, e.g. ts_classification_sequence_position = 1 ts_mrid = 2, group ts_point_dt_start_cet. cache lives lifetime one Claude Desktop session (docker run --rm -container). Example workflow Claude run “Weekly average German load January 2024”: area_eic(query = "Germany") — resolve EIC code load(eic = "10Y1001A1001A83F", period_start = "2024-01-01", period_end = "2024-02-01") — envelope table = load_actual_<hash> sql_query(sql = "SELECT date_trunc('week', ts_point_dt_start_cet) wk, AVG(ts_point_quantity)::INT avg_mw load_actual_<hash> GROUP 1 ORDER 1") — 5 weekly rows instead 2,976 quarter-hourly rows

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
text: Always call area_eic first resolve country name EIC code querying data. Many countries multiple bidding zones (e.g. Norway NO1–NO5). Fetch generously, aggregate via SQL. 100-row cap applies sql_query output — cached DuckDB table holds full result. Fetch month year data , aggregate weekly / daily values via sql_query(...). generation time-series, omit gen_type get production types, filter codes like B16 (Solar) B18 (Wind offshore). Never accept synthetic values. Every data-fetching tool explicitly instructs LLM generate synthetic data live ENTSO-E tool available. Claude produces values without calling tool, ask retry using appropriate tool. server also sends rules client MCP instructions session starts, model sees workflow (EIC first, fetch , aggregate sql_query) first tool call.

title: entsoeapi.mcp 0.1.0
text: Provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes entsoeapi package 26 structured tools LLM-enabled applications Claude Desktop. Tools cover major ENTSO-E Transparency Platform domains: EIC lookup – area, party, resource-object -approved EIC codes, ENTSO-E news. Load – actual, day-ahead, week-ahead, month-ahead, year-ahead, margin load (unified tool_load type parameter). Generation – time-series (tool_gen_time_series) installed capacity (tool_gen_capacity), merging several underlying API document types. Market – day-ahead energy prices, intraday prices, net transfer capacities, day-ahead commercial schedules, explicit offered transfer capacities, flow-based allocations, congestion income, allocated transfer capacities third countries. Transmission – cross-border physical flows, total commercial schedules, net positions, forecasted transfer capacities. Outages – generation units, production units, transmission grid. Balancing – imbalance prices, imbalance volumes, contracted reserves.

title: entsoeapi.mcp 0.1.0
text: MCP server runs stdin/stdout via mcptools::mcp_server(); ENTSOE_PAT security token read automatically environment. tool results serialised CSV (instead JSON), reducing context-window token usage 60–70 % wide time-series data frames. Results capped 100 rows truncation notice appended data partial. Uninformative constant columns (repeated domain names, currency codes, unit labels) dropped every result via internal slim_ts() helper, reducing payload size. HTTP response headers printed httr2::req_verbose() suppressed can corrupt JSON-RPC stream MCP stdio transport. Tool argument descriptions steer LLM toward short date ranges avoid unnecessarily large API responses.
